extracted.intended_audience: researchers, publishers, editors, and other scholarly communication stakeholders
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and community-level goals for improving the peer review process, with emphasis on innovation and technology (including responsible AI use), transparency, efficiency, integrity, inclusivity, and recognition of reviewers and editors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality of peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: Quality peer review in whatever shape or form it may take is critical to scholarly communication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Peer Review Week exists to celebrate and emphasize the central role peer review plays in maintaining research quality; community activities aim to foster discussion and share approaches that uphold high-quality review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency in peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: There is a rising demand for greater transparency in the peer review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transparency is presented as a desired attribute alongside efficiency; events and resources during PRW aim to highlight and discuss practices that increase openness in peer review workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Efficiency and streamlining
rubrics_metrics.description: There is increasing demand for greater efficiency in the peer review process to cope with surging publications and limited reviewer supply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Innovations are being designed to streamline processes and better align peer review with authors' needs; technology (including AI) is discussed as a means to automate administrative tasks so reviewers can focus on substantive assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: Significant emphasis on research integrity within the evolving academic landscape.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page asks whether the industry's research integrity crisis can be tackled with new approaches and technology, implying that tools and practices should support detection/prevention of integrity issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appropriate, complementary use of AI
rubrics_metrics.description: AI should be used in a way that complements the value that the reviewer brings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AI tools are suggested for automating administrative tasks to free reviewers for important aspects of review; discussions focus on ensuring technology complements human expertise rather than replacing it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Broadening and diversifying the reviewer pool (inclusivity/equity)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of technology (including AI) to broaden the pool of reviewers and provide equal opportunities to scholars from under-represented countries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One explicit question posed is how technology can be used to broaden reviewer participation and equity; this implies evaluative attention to practices that reduce geographic and demographic barriers to reviewing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for interdisciplinary and global collaboration
rubrics_metrics.description: Peer review should remain effective as research becomes more interdisciplinary and requires global collaboration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The committee highlights that interdisciplinary solutions and cross-pollination of ideas are crucial for global challenges (e.g., UN SDGs), and asks how peer review and technology can facilitate exchange across disciplines and geographies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author-centric alignment
rubrics_metrics.description: Peer review innovations should better align the process with the needs of authors in an increasingly author-centric landscape.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page notes the academic landscape is becoming more author-centric and suggests innovations aim to make peer review more responsive to authors' needs while preserving quality and integrity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognition and showcasing of editors and reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: Highlight and showcase the work of editors and reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One stated purpose of Peer Review Week is to emphasize and celebrate the contributions of editors and reviewers; programs and communications should include recognition and visibility components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sharing and advancing best practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Share research and advance best practices in peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PRW activities (blog posts, videos, podcasts, infographics, resources) are positioned as channels for disseminating research, guidance, and community-vetted best practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Highlighting innovations and practical applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Highlight the latest peer review innovations and their applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The event focuses on how new approaches and technologies are being applied in peer review; activities and resources should surface practical examples and lessons learned from innovators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community-led, global engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Peer review improvement is best pursued via community-led, global engagement and dialogue.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Peer Review Week is described as a community-led yearly global virtual event; the page invites broad participation and collaboration across institutions, publishers, and researchers to discuss and implement improvements.
